name: Almost Heaven Grandview 4-6 Person Canopy Barrel Sauna, 7x7+1 ft. – 1 ft. Porch
description: Almost Heaven Grandview 7'x8' DIY Barrel Sauna With 1' Porch The Grandview is made for sauna parties. Measuring 7’x8’, it is a full foot wider than the standard barrel sauna and can fit up to six people. It also has one foot of space allotted to exterior benches, which can hold people, water, towels, and even logs if you opt to upgrade to a wood-burning heater! The sauna comes standard with the Harvia KIP80B 8 kW electric heater, which gets the space to 180ºF and beyond. The sauna can start heating right away, or you can delay the start time by up to eight hours. Stretch out solo in all the extra space or invite friends or the whole family to join; the choice is yours! Features Ball-and-socket lumber: 1-3/8″ thick Any glass features are tempered Stainless steel bands, hinges, and fasteners Interior LED light Sauna stones included Weather-proof polymer support cradles Two opposite-facing benches for sitting or reclining Two exterior opposite-facing benches Indoor or outdoor usage Hand-crafted lumber profiles and end sections Best-in-class heater & sauna stones Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Made in the USA Specifications Holds between four and six people Standard heater (Harvia KIP80B): 8 kW, 240V, 40-amp electrical requirement, hardwire connect Wood-burning stove upgrade: Harvia M3 or HUUM Hive Heat 12 wood stove with chimney installation kit Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Assembled Size: 81"W x 94"D x 85"H Interior Room Size: 79"W x 75"D x 79"H Interior bench dimensions: 20″W x 75″L x 22″H Canopy porch size: 83″W x 12″D x 83″H Exterior bench dimensions: 20″W x 12″L x 22″H Cradle dimensions 54" x 6 Shipping weight: 1,020 lbs Shipping size: 42″W x 95″L x 55″H Note: All dimensions are approximate Options & Customizations Vista or Port rear window: Open the Grandview barrel sauna interior to breathtaking views with the addition of the Vista or Port rear window. Door style: Outfit your 4-6 person canopy barrel sauna with one of the following deluxe door options: full glass door, wood door with a window, or all-wood door. Stains: Choose from our range of exterior sauna stains, available in Natural, Walnut, Larch, and Teak shades, to perfectly complement your selected lumber type. Heater: The Almost Heaven Grandview barrel sauna can be paired with a wide range of electric or wood-burning heaters. See product options for all available heaters. Care & Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Shipping & Assembly The Grandview will ship via a flatbed truck. Mid-level handyman and assembly skills are recommended for this sauna. Minimal sawing or modifying certain components may be necessary during the assembly process. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6-8 hours. It is recommended that you review the installation manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity.
